Here are the growing conditions for Doronicum plantagineum (Plantain-leaved Leopard's Bane):

• **Temperature:** 15-20°C
• **Hydrometry:** 60-70%
• **Sunshine:** 4-6 hours
• **Rainfall:** 800-1200mm
• **Humidity:** 50-65%
• **Soil:** Humus-rich
• **Climate:** Temperate-cool
